name: diagnostic-statistical-model-inference
intent: Evaluate model fit and inferential limits through explicit estimand, assumptions, diagnostics, uncertainty, and sensitivity evidence.
successCondition: Stop when diagnostics, sensitivity, uncertainty, and the strongest supportable claim class are explicit.
outputs: bounded inference with assumption and uncertainty ledger
operations: inspect residual calibration influence and collinearity
separate descriptive predictive and causal claims
preconditions: the dataset provenance and intended estimand are known
diagnostic assumptions are falsifiable where possible
positiveTriggers: Diagnose a statistical model before interpreting coefficients or predictions.
Test inferential sensitivity to assumptions specification and influential observations.
negativeTriggers: Claim a causal effect without an identification design.
Issue medical financial or legal conclusions from a model.
failureModes: stop causal interpretation when identification assumptions are absent
report instability when plausible specifications reverse the conclusion
exclusions: does not prove causality from fit
does not replace domain or regulated expert review
terminationConditions: Stop when diagnostics, sensitivity, uncertainty, and the strongest supportable claim class are explicit.

measurableImprovement.baseline: the current eternities-athena route without this exact operational mechanism
measurableImprovement.threshold: all critical cases pass with exact evidence and no authority or effect regression
